drafts.title: The Baton Rouge 2024 confrontation fixture keeps eight fields per pass and no processing identifier, cycle, pass number or crossover calibration quality, so which processing a pass came from cannot be read from it

relates_to.why: the recipe's worked example runs on this file and its inputs ask for passes with the collection named. This draft adds what the file does not carry beyond the collection name. It changes none of the recipe's numbers or rules.
that page says the reach granule has 127 attributes and that the processing identifier varies within a collection; this draft only records that a working file keeps eight of them. No conflict.
that page dates the two Version D processing identifiers; this draft uses those dates and adds nothing about lakes. No conflict.
that page is why the file names its collection; this draft is about the level below the collection, the processing identifier, which the file does not keep. No conflict.

drafts.title: In the 2024 Baton Rouge worked example two of the 50 paired passes carry nine tenths of the squared departure, so its change RMSD of 0.38 m describes those two passes and not the typical one

relates_to.why: it does not dispute the recipe's numbers, which reproduce exactly. It narrows how the worked example is read: the recipe says the disagreement is not explained by the product's stated precision because the change RMSD is about four times it, and on this file that ratio is carried by two of 50 passes; with those two left out by date it is about 1.1. The recipe's method and refusals are untouched. Whether the worked example should say so is the steward's decision.

that page gives the Version D range at this reach in 2024 as -0.534 to 10.201 m. The lower end is the single pass of 2024-10-30, which sits about 2 m below the gauge; the next lowest paired Version D height in the pass table is 1.295 m. Its point, that Versions C and D differ by metres, is not disputed.
same product; that page describes the collections and their attributes, this one a property of one year's comparison at one reach. No conflict.
another gauge confrontation recipe, for modelled flow; shares only the form of the scores. No conflict.

drafts.title: A reach height set beside a point gauge differs from it by the water surface slope times the distance between them, and where that slope rises with stage the distance reads as a gain: the recipe's 0.44 km does not say what it is measured to

relates_to.why: the recipe states the pair is 0.44 km apart and scores changes. This draft does not say that figure is wrong; it says the recipe leaves unstated which two points it joins and in which direction, and adds why that matters for any fit of satellite height on gauge height. The recipe's change scores are untouched: a slope effect that grows with stage is not a constant offset, so it is not removed by differencing, which the recipe does not discuss.

that page says a reach value is the product's aggregate over roughly 10 km and that every statistic names its level. This draft adds one consequence when a reach value is set beside a point measurement. No conflict.
that page lists slope among the reach attributes and describes reaches as roughly 10 km aggregates; this draft uses the slope field and adds no fact about the product itself. No conflict.
also about a point and a river line not being the same place, for another service. No conflict.

drafts.title: At one Mississippi reach in 2024 reach_q read 1 on 49 of 52 passes, 2 on 3 and never 0, and this bundle does not say what any reach_q value means

relates_to.why: that page names reach_q and calls the quality attributes categorical gates; it gives no values. This draft adds a census of the values at one reach in one year and states that their meaning is missing from the bundle. It conflicts with nothing there.

that page gives the ladder of the lake flag quality_f (0 good, 1 suspect, 2 degraded, 3 bad) from the lake product description. This draft does not carry that ladder to reach_q, because no source read says the river flag shares it. No conflict.
the recipe's worked example is the same reach and year and says nothing about quality flags. This draft adds the census of the flag on those passes and changes none of the recipe's numbers.
same product and level; that page is about quoting statistics at the wrong aggregation level, this one about a flag whose values are undefined in the bundle. No conflict.
